answer: Each new key posts a bond locked for nine epochs—longer than one challenge window—so the same coins cannot hop across aliases inside a single vote. It must also show recent jobs with three uncorrelated counterparties; a self-dealing ring never qualifies. Picture a delivery from an orchard warehouse across the tundra to a stall that sells sable goods: three different customers have to sign the receipts. A fifty-name farm must lock fifty nine-epoch bonds and complete real work for fifty distinct counterparties.
